_comment: TEMPLATE for onboarding a new client. Copy to clients/<client>.json, fill every value, then run: python3 build.py <client>. Leading underscore = ignored by the builder.
_checklist: 1. Create a NEW Supabase project in London (eu-west-2). One project per client = physical isolation. Never share a project.
2. Run the schema + RLS migrations against it (tenant_state, roles, role_assessments, role_documents, contract_analysis).
3. Confirm Auth > Providers > sign-ups are DISABLED, and email confirmations are on.
4. Confirm Auth > URL Configuration Site URL is https://ir35workbench.co.uk/<folder>/ and the redirect allow-list covers it.
5. Fill this file in, run the build, commit, and wait for the GitHub Pages deploy.
6. Provision users admin-side and set app_metadata.tenant to CLIENT_ID for every one of them.
7. Run the isolation self-test (register G-04) BEFORE giving the client the URL: sign in as this client and prove you cannot read another client's store.
SECTOR: Sector shown on the dashboard, e.g. Renewable energy
